reason: Replacing alcohol only in the deny rule leaves the reimbursement exclusion intact. The receipted alcohol candidate at the base amount 42.50 changes from deny to fallback review; every changed literal-stratum case remains below 75, so the signature is present.

Dropping the amount guard changes the permitted, receipted candidates at 75 and 76 from review to reimburse and removes the pack's only ordered comparison. The ledger is caught but has no threshold signature.

Changing committee escalation to force approve changes the spend candidates at 250000 and 250001. The unchanged approval guard and committee condition both use the sole boundary 250000; the disagreeing at-row prevents a signature.

Moving committee escalation down to 187500 changes the clean candidate at 249999 from approve to unresolved. All changed candidates lie in [187500,250000), strictly below the unchanged approval boundary 250000. Section 5 needs one qualifying literal, so that mirror suffices even if another literal has an at-row.

The embargoed candidate changes from forced decline-redirect to unresolved with exception-escalation. This pack contains no ordered comparison, so a caught ledger cannot carry the threshold signature.

Reversing matchCount >= 1 to <= 1 makes the present-evidence candidate at 0 conflict and the candidate at 2 yield no-match. Both sides of the retained boundary 1 disagree, while 1 itself is unchanged; the signature is absent.

Removing appropriateness=pass permits proceed on complete, non-embargoed requests with both required evidence items present and appropriateness hard-fail, pending, not-evaluable, or an outside value. Those cases change from decline, clarify, or fallback to conflict or proceed. Their per-row probability is (1/3)*(1/2)*(1/4)*(4/5)=1/30, giving ledger catch probability 1-(29/30)^20, approximately 0.4924. The interval predicts the observed fraction of thirty ledgers; it is not a structural certainty.

Dropping sanctions status=clear changes only complete, tax-received cases below 250000 with both required evidence items present and an outside-domain status. A match is still forced to reject and a clear status is unchanged. Under the registered generator this event has probability approximately (1/3)^3*(1/2)*(1/4)=1/216 per row, giving approximately 0.0886 catch probability at n=20. The interval predicts the observed fraction of thirty ledgers.
